patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clay and Demandbase share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Clay only if your buying job matches “GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall prospecting — Free ” rather than Demandbase's shape. Choose Demandbase only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, intent, and go-to-marke” rather than Clay's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Clay is shaped for GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall whereas Demandbase is shaped for Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, int. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clay and Demandbase share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Clay is GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall prospecting — Free + Launch from ~$167/mo headline, Growth, Enterpris; Demandbase is Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, intent, and go-to-market orchestration — custom-quote packaging..
- Company-size focus: Clay (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Demandbase (mid-market, enterprise).
- Researched limits: Clay — Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model; Demandbase — Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices.

Limitations — Clay: Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model; Credit consumption across providers requires ongoing cost governance; Demandbase: Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices; Enterprise ABM scope means substantial implementation and change-management cost.

Poor-fit cases: Clay is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model · Demandbase is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices · Avoid Clay if you actually need Demandbase's motion (Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, intent, and g)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
